{"candidate": {"code": "    def assign_partition(self, key: str, num_partitions: int | None = None) -> int:
        """Return the partition ID for *key*.

        BUG_58: uses ``hash(key) % (num_partitions + 1)`` which can
        return ``num_partitions`` itself -- an out-of-range value
        (valid range is ``0 .. num_partitions - 1``).  The fix must
        use ``hash(key) % num_partitions`` instead.
        """
        n = num_partitions if num_partitions is not None else self._config.num_partitions
        # BUG_58: modulo must stay within [0, n) so we avoid returning n
        partition_id = _stable_hash(key) % n
        return partition_id", "comments": "Use modulo n so hash-derived partition IDs stay within the valid range."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug58_modulus_and_health", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug58/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Correct modulus AND health degradation report via orgops.health.report_degradation.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the modulus to hash(key) % num_partitions (removing the +1) AND report a cache.partition.skew degradation signal via orgops.health.report_degradation()?"}]}
